Backproject parcel-level MEDuSA coefficients onto a 4D NIfTI brain mask

Source: R/backproject_medusa.R
backproject_medusa.Rd

Maps parcel-by-time model statistics (for example from [mixed_by()]) back into 4D NIfTI volumes (3D space across event-locked timepoints) using an integer-valued 3D parcellation mask.

Usage

backproject_medusa(
  coef_df,
  brain_mask,
  plot_cols = NULL,
  parcel_col = "roi",
  time_col = "time",
  effect_col = "term",
  output_dir = getwd(),
  ncpus = 4L
)

Arguments

coef_df

A `data.frame` containing parcel, time, optional effect, and statistic columns to write.

brain_mask

Path to a 3D integer-valued NIfTI parcellation mask.

plot_cols

Character vector of numeric column names in `coef_df` to backproject.

parcel_col

Column name in `coef_df` identifying integer mask parcel values. Default `"roi"`.

time_col

Column name in `coef_df` identifying event-locked timepoints. Default `"time"`.

effect_col

Column name in `coef_df` identifying model terms/effects, or `NULL` if `coef_df` contains a single effect. Default `"term"`.

output_dir

Output directory where `.nii.gz` files will be written. Default `getwd()`.

ncpus

Integer number of parallel worker processes. Default `4L`.

Value

Invisibly returns a character vector of written `.nii.gz` file paths.
